  The x-ai/grok-4_20 finding about the heredoc in `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` matching the refusal regex is INCORRECT. The `_runtime_failure_path_line` variable is set to either "- model refused (safety filter)" or "- unavailable (editor fallback)", neither of which match the anchored refusal pattern `^I'?m sorry,? but I (can ?not|can.?t) assist` or `^I (can ?not|can.?t) help with that`.

  The x-ai/grok-4_20 finding about stale `.utf8XXXXXX` temp files is overstated. The function does clean up via `rm -f "${_tmp}"` in multiple exit paths (lines 58, 64, 70, 75, 78), and the fail-open design prioritizes continuation over temp file hygiene.

  The x-ai/grok-4_20 finding about the test file's `except Exception` swallowing tracebacks is minor - this is a standard pattern for simple test runners and does not affect correctness, only debuggability.

  The mistralai/mistral-small-2603 and consensus finding about the added `text.count('_REFUSAL_REGEX=') == 1` assertion is CORRECT and valid - it properly enforces the documented contract that the regex should be defined exactly once.
